items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He's probably bothered that he used to be, after he studied with Kall Cat.

ctx.x: But he plays so well, really. Maybe he shouldn't try classical, although he loves it. He's not so successful at that.
He's probably bothered that he used to be, after he studied with Kall Cat.

I think it's deeper than that. Jazz is his thing. The other he loves and there is no doubt that he loves it, he doesn't do it for prestige. That may be there, but I don't think that's the main reason. I think if he really didn't love it, he wouldn't do it. It does something for him, but he doesn't have the heritage training of that sort of thing, the sort of thing that you must do when you're very young.
